select p.project_id, p.project_name, p.special_id, p.system_code, '' system_name, p.viscus_code, '' viscus_name, count(ts.slide_id) slide_total, p. del_flag, p.create_by, u.user_name, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p. text_1, p.text_2 from tb_project p left join sys_user u on p.create_by=u.user_id AND u.status=0 left join tb_slide ts on ts.project_id=p.project_id and ts.is_delete=0 WHERE p.special_id = #{specialId} AND p.del_flag=0
AND u.user_name like concat('%', #{createName}, '%')
AND p.project_name like concat('%', #{projectName}, '%')
AND p.system_code = #{systemCode}
AND p.viscus_code = #{viscusCode}
AND date_format(p.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= date_format(#{beginTime},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND date_format(p.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= date_format(#{endTime},'%Y-%m-%d')
group by p.project_id order by p.project_id desc
